description: This file defines an interface IController within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace. The interface includes methods for persisting, deleting, rebooting, and managing environment and configuration data, as well as cloning controllers. It is marked as deprecated and external, indicating it is an older or transitional API component.

classes.name: IController
classes.description: An interface for controlling and managing plugin controllers, including persistence, deletion, reboot, environment, configuration, and cloning operations.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Persists the current state or configuration.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource specified by the path.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboots the controller or associated system.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the environment information for a given index.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a given callsign.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the controller with a new callsign.
